name: Human
summary: Everyone wakes as a Human: the only path that is safe in daylight, and the only one with a stat tree.
daylight: Safe. Humans take no sun damage.
blood: None. Humans never need to feed.
weaknesses: The slowest climb of any path: levelling your stats takes time

sections.heading: Playstyle
sections.body: Humans rise through villager quests, notice-board bounties and hunting. Quest cash buys better weapons, and bounties pay per kill. Reported bounties include *Kill 20 NPCs in city* (70 XP and $50) and *Kill 5 guards* (55 XP and $60).

sections.heading: Weapons
sections.body:
- Fists, to begin with
- [[wood-stake]]: punishes a vampire who comes too close
- [[flintlock]]: a ranged hunting weapon
- [[shotgun]]: wooden pellets, 8 rounds, a headshot decapitates

sections.heading: The stat tree
sections.body: Humans are the only path with a stat tree. Raising Strength makes the [[dagger]], [[rapier]], [[throwing-knife]] and [[white-oak-ash-dagger]] hit harder.

tips: Do outdoor quests while the sun is up, and buy a better weapon before night falls.
Changed your mind about a race? A [[human-potion]] from the [[general-shop]] turns you back.
